description: This file contains the implementation of the ExceptionContext class, which manages detailed contextual information for exceptions in the Apache Commons Math library. It stores throwable references, localized message patterns and arguments, and additional key-value context data. The class provides methods for adding messages, setting and retrieving context data, generating localized messages, and custom serialization/deserialization logic.

classes.name: ExceptionContext
classes.description: A class that provides stored context information about exceptions, including localized messages, arbitrary key-value data, and serialization support within the Apache Commons Math library.

methods.name: getThrowable
methods.description: Returns the throwable object this context refers to.

methods.name: addMessage
methods.description: Adds a localized message pattern and its arguments to the context.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets a key-value pair in the context data.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value associated with a given key from the context data.

methods.name: getKeys
methods.description: Returns all keys stored in the context.

methods.name: getMessage
methods.description: Returns the aggregated message string in default locale.

methods.name: getLocalizedMessage
methods.description: Returns the localized message string in the default locale.

methods.name: getMessage
methods.description: Returns the message string in a specified locale with a separator.

methods.name: buildMessage
methods.description: Constructs the message string by formatting message patterns with arguments.

methods.name: writeObject
methods.description: Serializes the object, including messages and context.

methods.name: readObject
methods.description: Deserializes the object, restoring messages and context.

methods.name: serializeMessages
methods.description: Handles serialization of message patterns and arguments.

methods.name: deSerializeMessages
methods.description: Handles deserialization of message patterns and arguments.

methods.name: nonSerializableReplacement
methods.description: Provides a placeholder string for objects that cannot be serialized.
